fields.name: interpreter_linkage_base
fields.meaning: Pointer to the following interpreter-linkage vector table

fields.name: system_service_base_vector
fields.meaning: Base of the high-memory three-byte service entries

fields.name: io_result_address
fields.meaning: Address of the two-byte I/O-result cell

fields.name: zero_page_workspace_address
fields.meaning: Address of the current runtime scratch-pointer workspace

windows.evidence: Four native relocation passes; final pass loads D1AD/D1AE into 92/93
Relocation-count/offset walker adds the 92/93 base to target words
Runtime error handler writes the I/O-result word
Local use of the 7E/7F scratch-pointer workspace
Beginning of the three-byte system-service entry array

historical.difference: Final scratch-workspace pointer is 0074 in Pascal 1.1 and 007E in SunDog

limits: The inventoried SunDog native procedures have empty interpreter relocation lists; no new live dereference through every table slot is claimed.
